properties.name: MEASURED (0.87.0 and 0.88.0): field limitation 24 did not reproduce — describe_schema's brief form for review_relations carries input_schema.$defs.RelationLinkReq whole, and its input_schema is identical to --describe's; what is real is that nested items arrive as $ref to resolve by hand, under a key path that differs between the brief form (input_schema) and the full form (served.inputSchema)
properties.statement: Field limitation 24 (VS Code --call run, 2026-10-19, 0.87.0) says describe_schema's brief form leaves `links.items` as {"$ref": "#/$defs/RelationLinkReq"} "with the $defs not included", while full: true and `reflow2-mcp --describe review_relations` show the fields. MEASURED on a scratch design with both 0.87.0 and 0.88.0: `--call describe_schema --args '{"tool":"review_relations"}'` returns form "brief" with input_schema keys [$defs, $schema, additionalProperties, properties, required, type]; $defs holds RelationLinkReq with every property; `--describe review_relations` returns the SAME input_schema (the two replies differ only in lessons.none_because wording and full_form's pointer). CANDIDATES: (A) brief_schema drops $defs — REFUTED (measured; the_brief_schema_differs_from_the_served_one_only_in_prose pins it). (B) reply_budget::bound_reply removed $defs on a larger design — REFUTED by its code: it shortens strings and, only for sampling tools, lists, and never removes a key; not measured on a design over the budget. (C) a design-dependent difference (lessons) — not reproduced; lessons ride outside input_schema. (D) the observation: the reader followed links.items to a $ref and looked for the definitions where the full form keeps them (served.inputSchema.$defs) rather than at input_schema.$defs, or saw a cut terminal print — CANNOT be told apart from each other without the field transcript, and is the reading the measurements leave. WHAT IS REAL either way: nested shapes arrive as $ref the reader must resolve, and the two forms put the schema under different key paths (input_schema vs served.inputSchema). The guide's limitation 24 text, as written, is not true of 0.87.0 for review_relations. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
